entry.title: 🚫 NOT Another Boring Energizer - P.1: Wall of Travel Souls
entry.summary:
Most energizers are forgotten the second they end. This is a concept I created for my remote team - and it's one of the few energizers that left people smiling after the call, not just during it. A team-building experience based on personal travel memories. ⏳ Duration: 20–30 min 🎯 Purpose: Emotional connection, storytelling, light creativity 💻 Format: Remote or hybrid-friendly 📸 Prep: Ask team to send 1 meaningful photo from any trip — past or recent A shared wall (Miro, Figma, Canva, Jamboard, etc.) A simple avatar template (or let them freestyle) 1 short, open-ended prompt Think of one special moment from any vacation or trip. A quiet moment, a funny accident, something magical. Use the template to build a character or space that shows the essence of that memory. Write 1–3 sentences next to it to bring it to life. Hey team! Prepare 2–3 sample cards ahead of time (include yours!) Screenshot the final wall and send it out after the meeting as a memory Here’s a little glimpse of how my board looked during the session.
👀 Liked the vibe? This is just one of many energizers I’ve cooked up. Follow me to catch the next drop – and maybe steal a few sparks for your own sessions 🌟
